[adapters]
  --- adapters.directory: string
[console]
  --- console.url: string
[evidence]
  --- evidence.accept_schema_majors: array
  -S- evidence.allowed_source_hosts: array
  -S- evidence.freeweight_api_key_env: string
  -S- evidence.freeweight_api_key_file: string
  -S- evidence.freeweight_url: string
  --- evidence.import_interval_hours: number ≥ 0
[execution]
  --- execution.attempt_backoff_seconds: number ≥ 0
  --- execution.default_timeout_seconds: number ≥ 0
  --- execution.max_attempts: integer ≥ 1
  --- execution.max_concurrent_jobs: integer ≥ 1
[logging]
  --- logging.format: string {text,json,auto}
  -S- logging.include_content: boolean
  --- logging.level: string
[provider]
  -S- provider.base_url: string
  --- provider.fake: object
  -S- provider.kind: string
  --- provider.timeout_seconds: number ≥ 0
[providers]
  -S- providers.allow_remote: boolean
[queue]
  --- queue.ageing_interval_seconds: integer ≥ 1
  --- queue.ageing_priority_per_minute: number ≥ 0
  --- queue.cancelling_watchdog_seconds: integer ≥ 1
  --- queue.idempotency_ttl_hours: number ≥ 0
  --- queue.lease_renewal_interval_seconds: integer ≥ 1
  --- queue.lease_seconds: integer ≥ 1
  --- queue.max_active_per_source: integer ≥ 0
  --- queue.max_affinity_streak: integer ≥ 1
  --- queue.max_depth: integer ≥ 1
  --- queue.max_wait_seconds: integer ≥ 1
  --- queue.overflow_allowance: integer ≥ 0
  --- queue.poll_interval_ms: integer ≥ 1
  L-- queue.draining: boolean
  L-- queue.paused: boolean
[residency]
  --- residency.max_resident_models: integer ≥ 1
  --- residency.unload_idle_seconds: integer ≥ 0
[routing]
  --- routing.base_switch_penalty: number 0 … 1
  --- routing.explanation_retention_days: integer ≥ 0
  L-- routing.min_confidence: number 0 … 1
  L-- routing.min_present_weight: number 0 … 1
  L-- routing.prefer_resident_bonus: number 0 … 1
  L-- routing.remote_cost_factor: number 0.01 … 1
  --- routing.require_adapter_evidence: boolean
  --- routing.strategy: string
  --- routing.task_profiles_path: string
[runtime]
  --- runtime.context_size: integer ≥ 0
  --- runtime.flash_attention: boolean
  --- runtime.keep_alive: string
  --- runtime.kv_cache_precision: string {,f16,q8_0,q4_0}
  --- runtime.models: object
[server]
  -S- server.allow_lan_exposure: boolean
  -S- server.allowed_hosts: array
  --- server.failed_auth_per_minute: integer ≥ 0
  -S- server.host: string
  --- server.max_body_bytes: integer ≥ 1024
  -S- server.port: integer 1 … 65535
  --- server.rate_limit_burst: integer ≥ 1
  --- server.rate_limit_per_minute: integer ≥ 0
  -S- server.trusted_proxies: array
[storage]
  --- storage.auto_migrate: boolean
  --- storage.backup_retention: integer ≥ 0
  L-- storage.content_retention_hours: integer 0 … 8760

  -S- storage.retain_content: boolean
  --- storage.statement_timeout_ms: integer ≥ 0
[telemetry]
  --- telemetry.interval_ms: integer ≥ 0
